question: Can target-blind bounded typed search select a proof-equivalent modular-power composition because a DAG cost recognizes reusable work?

search.targetLeakage: unreachable sentinel only; known factored form is not passed to search, ranking, or stopping
search.providerRelation: finite structural traversal, both factor orders, complete=true
search.verification: independent shape audit of one legal modular-exponent composition plus source/target/application binding

cost.tree: sum exponent-bit work over every modpow occurrence
cost.dag: sum exponent-bit work over structurally unique modpow calls
cost.exponentProductWork: saturated sum of declared factor bit lengths

green: all TEST cases finish with complete bounded relation
DAG-selected state is strictly cheaper than original
selected state contains the reusable modpow(a,e,n) as the base of the q exponentiation
TREE_COST gives no artificial strict advantage for the same composition
negative control gives no strict DAG advantage
all accepted moves carry independent verification receipts
success.yellow: correct but only partially satisfies GREEN
success.red: incorrect proof, target leakage, post-TEST tuning, or no reusable-work advantage

boundaries: This does not claim discovery of the modular exponent law.
The exact relation N-1=q*e is considered known preprocessing for the structured candidate.
This is a research-only arithmetic-program micro-domain, not a production optimizer.
External Primachsenraum JMH results are post-hoc evaluation only.
